verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents syncing tokens across devices via iCloud/Google Drive and lists 'Multi-device sync (encrypted)' as a feature, and computer access is possible through a browser extension that confirms via the mobile app. However, this cross-device access relies on manual confirmation from the phone rather than tokens being independently and automatically available on a tablet/computer at all times, and multi-device sync appears gated behind a paid tier for the Pass product. Missing for 10: evidence of true simultaneous, always-available token access across phone/tablet/computer without per-use phone confirmation, and confirmation that Auth (not just Pass) multi-device sync is free and automatic.
